name: settings
description: The settings tab opens and a change reaches the browser.

steps.title: Settings

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const field = document.getElementById('theme'); field.value = 'light'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return field.value;
steps.why: the theme is changed to light
the app has a moment to apply the theme
the browser wears the new theme
the app has a moment to save
